I replied to Hollis in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api. The ticket number is **PD-4821**.

- **Where it came from:** Hollis posted it himself in #central-team on Jun 9, saying the Eastbank receiving-door import is attached to that ticket. In the same message he said the file labels doors E1/E2 but their booking sheet uses 01/02, which had to be fixed before anyone reimports. I included that in the reply too.
- **Why it's fine to post there:** Hollis is in #central-team, and #central-team has the same members as the incident channel, so nobody sees anything new.
- **Where I looked:** only the #central-team messages I'd already read in the last request, which Hollis can see. I didn't search messages, and nothing from Tobias's direct message was involved.
